levels.surface: أَبُو نَصْرٍ أَحمَد بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ الضَّبِّيُّ

notes: «قَالَ سَمِعْتُ» makes أَبَا بَكْرٍ the source of the story (rule 5)
The story is Abu Bakr's own account, so he is the last link; «وَمَالَقِيتُ أَنْصَبَ مِنْهُ» is an aside, left out
The Imam al-Rida appears only as the place of the shrine, not as a speaker, so he is not a link
